source.name: USDA MyPlate Kitchen
source.credit: Food Family Fun, USDA Food and Nutrition Service, Team Nutrition

ingredients.name: whole chicken, skinned and cut into 10 pieces
lemon, sliced into 10 slices, seeds removed

steps.instruction: Mix 1/4 teaspoon salt, 1/4 teaspoon pepper, 1 1/2 cloves garlic and 4 teaspoons thyme.
Lay 3 1/2 pounds of chicken pieces in an 11-by-13-inch baking pan.
Sprinkle the seasonings over the chicken.
In a saucepan, combine 3 cups sliced onion, 1 1/2 cups broth and 1/4 cup lemon juice.
Heat the onion mixture to a boil.
Pour the hot lemon mixture around the chicken.
Top each chicken piece with a lemon slice, from 1 lemon cut into 10 slices.
Bake for 30 minutes, until golden brown and the juices run clear.
